# FLX-3707: there is nothing to fit

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

fluxsim calibrate --fit needs a bundle that declares consumers, a calibration block with at least one parameter, and a pinned profile whose queries section states the rate of at least one calibration query. The held-out queries are never fitted. The message names what is missing. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3707
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
